decisions_beyond_the_cell: The tree's parenthesis is '(row N: TYPED)', not '(<name>)': the door's suggestion carries no name (surprise row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W160-S1).
filingHints keeps the inherited gate proxyableFindings, which admits a finding only when the door's actions include NAME_PROXY (surprise row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W160-S2).

Replace refuses three inputs in words, sending nothing: a blank input ('Type the ticker you meant.'), a shape the door does not accept ('Type a ticker: letters, digits and . : _ / - only.', the shape of the door's own ticker value), and the same symbol or a case-only change ('Type a different ticker; the same symbol, or a change of case alone, is not sent.'). These three sentences are the worker's; the cell names only the first.

correctionsFor drops a case-only pair silently (the rule 'never a case-only pair'); a Yes whose suggestion differs only in case cannot reach it, because proxyableFindings already drops such a suggestion.
The tree's buttons are hidden at twenty symbols, as the existing Use gate was (useFull), and the existing 'No more than twenty' line is kept.
The Replace input is a component-local state (open, typed, refusal) inside UploadFindings; no new file was added.
not_read: the live upload door's answer to an equal pair (no live call was made; until release r33 the contract's CORRECTIONS_INVALID refusal is expected, shown through the existing refusal path)
r33's words (the TICKER_DATA_NOT_ENTITLED unresolved text 'Opal Staff will manage the replacement.' is the cell's, not read)
the live door's actions for TICKER_NOT_FOUND (whether NAME_PROXY is present, which the inherited gate requires; surprise row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W160-S2)
the rendered page (no dev server, no browser; states are rendered with renderToStaticMarkup and the presses on a happy-dom document)
